items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I think Ray Brown was playing bass, I was playing piano.

ctx.x: I think that was one on the tape where the sound level was off, so tell me about that record date again.

That's the one. I think Ray Brown was playing bass, I was playing piano. Jo Jones was playing drums. Roy Eldridge was playing trumpet, and that's the one where Ben Webster called up Norman Granz. We'd had a record date the day before. He called him up, he says, "Can you find the old man for me?" He's talking about Coleman Hawkins now.
